# Desktop runtime notices

`qt-6.8.1.txt` is generated by `cmake/SingleFile.cmake` from the exact Qt 6.8.1 source kit used by the Windows release. It retains the Qt module and bundled third-party license texts for the dynamic macOS/Linux packages as well. Native bridge notices come from the digest-verified bridge release separately.

When changing the Qt version or modules, regenerate this file from the matching source kit. Qt source is available at https://download.qt.io/archive/qt/6.8/6.8.1/ and https://code.qt.io/ . The dynamic packages allow replacing their Qt libraries; build instructions and Bugg source remain in this repository.
